label: Flavoured milk
step: add cocoa or flavour, sugar and stabiliser
note: Sold either pasteurised and chilled or UHT-treated so it keeps unrefrigerated. A carton of the chilled kind can hold as much sugar as a can of soft drink (2018 analysis of 90+ products).

about.text: Milk sweetened and flavoured, most often with cocoa, but also with coffee, malt, vanilla, strawberry or banana. It is sold pasteurised and chilled, or UHT-treated and shelf-stable.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

how.text: Carrageenan works in cocoa drinks mainly by interacting with milk proteins at neutral pH, forming a network that keeps the cocoa particles suspended. Kappa-carrageenan was more effective than lambda in UHT processing; too much stabiliser makes the milk lumpy or jelly-like, and sterilised milk needs less than UHT, UHT less than pasteurised.
